title: Exploring the catalytic activity of –NHSO3H functionalized natural asphalt: a sustainable and efficient catalyst for condensation reactions in water
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9280-9294
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00870K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sahar Abdolahi, Mohammad Soleiman-Beigi
Natural asphalt sulfamic acid (NA-NHSO3H) was synthesized through the functionalization of natural asphalt (NA). The catalytic performance of NA-NHSO3H was evaluated in Knoevenagel and Claisen–Schmidt condensation reactions under mild conditions.
